title: Something of Value
description: A Kenyan native (Sidney Poitier) is torn between his tribe and his British friend (Rock Hudson) during the Mau Mau crisis.

description: Nick and Janine live in bliss until her ex warps time to try to tear them apart by using Nick's old girlfriend. As Nick's memories and reality disappear, he must decide what he's willing to sacrifice to save -- or let go of -- everything he loves.

title: The Great Debaters
description: In the 1930s Texas, Mel Tolson inspires students at a predominantly black college to form a debate team and strive for the national championship.

title: Betty: They Say I'm Different
description: Betty Davis arrives on the '70s scene to break boundaries for women with her daring personality and outrageous funk music. She then, despite being banned and boycotted, goes on to become the first black woman to perform, write and manage herself.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S01 E08 — And Then You Die ...
A murderous escaped convict (Will Bledsoe) and his girlfriend take Althea (Anne-Marie Johnson) and a boy hostage.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S02 E01 — Don't Look Back
As Tibbs and Gillespie fight for control of the department, a murderer re-creating an old voodoo case stalks Gillespie.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:
S02 E03 — Family Secrets
A woman (Susan Blakely) who is accused of patricide claims she was a victim of incest. With Carroll O'Connor, Howard Rollins.

description: A young woman dream of making it big in the world of hip hop, but her parents demand that she finish college. She dutifully agrees to complete her education, however her spoken word proves to have a powerful impact in the classroom.

description: Three women (Halle Berry, Vivica A. Fox, Lela Rochon), all alleged widows of '50s singer Frankie Lymon, claim legal rights to his estate.

description: A documentary tribute to the pop-culture legacy of the beloved singer Aaliyah, as seen through key moments of her career prior to her untimely death.

title: Aaliyah: So Much More Than a Woman
description: A biography of R&B vocalist Aaliyah.

description: Recorded in 1993 at the Blue Note Jazz Club in New York City, this performance by Chaka Khan features a number of songs closely associated with jazz.

description:
S02 E12 — Only Built for Cuban Wandas
Wanda gets in over her head when she invites a controversial rap artist (RZA) on "The Beltway Gang."

Keith challenges Wanda to see his therapist (Cheryl Hines); Keith regrets his decision when Wanda suddenly admits her attraction to Bradley.

description:

description: Recorded in 1993 at the Blue Note Jazz Club in New York City, this performance by Chaka Khan features a number of songs closely associated with jazz.

description:

During Tibbs' old partner's (Michael Warren) visit, two FBI agents and a protected witness are murdered.

description:

Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) suspects Sheriff Thompson (Ed Ames), an old friend, may be responsible for a man's death. With Howard Rollins and Geoffrey Thorne.

title: In the Heat of the Night
description:

Bubba (Alan Autry) falls in love with a deceitful siren (Barbara Stock). With Carroll O'Connor and Howard Rollins.

description:

Virgil (Howard Rollins) questions his abilities after he fatally shoots a robbery suspect. With Carroll O'Connor.

title: Wanda at Large
description:
S02 E13 — Plane Trip
Discontented with the cost of flights, Wanda comes up with an unusual way of traveling abroad; her relationship takes a turn for the unexpected after she discovers that her date is an aerophobic.

title: Wanda at Large
description:
S02 E11 — The Unnatural
During another lonely Saturday night, Wanda, Keith and Jenny vow to go on dates with people without trying to pursue meaningful relationships; whoever cannot resist a second date must pay the others; unfortunately, all three meet great partners.

description:
S01 E07 — Flo's Dream

description:

Kevin Hart and YouTube creator Casey Neistat join forces at the beach to train with Los Angeles County lifeguards.

description:

description:

description:

A condemned man asks Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) to visit him the evening before his execution. With Howard Rollins.

Kevin Hart heads to Underwood Family Farms with experienced farmer Jennifer Garner, to become a farmer for a day.

Tibbs' father-in-law creates friction; Gillespie placates a city council angry over attacks on senior citizens.

Gillespie (Carroll O'Connor) believes an assault victim (guest star Caryn West) is lying about her attacker. With Howard Rollins.
